title: Add named bounded search triggers
changes: Add session-pinned named PC and bus search definitions with explicit save, list, show, enable, disable, remove and run commands. Definitions start disabled and management never executes a search.
Return hit or not-reached with the definition hash and original control response; preserve existing interpreter, watch-feature, conflict and resource limits.
validation: Windows GNU runtime and test builds passed; 19 focused Wine tests passed for trigger safety, named synthetic hit/miss responses, removal, parser/completion and operation registry.

An isolated EUR Wine/Xvfb interpreter verified a named Thumb hit and one-step miss with distinct identities, no guest change during configuration, disabled refusal without dispatch, unchanged protected inputs and normal GUI close. This run preceded the later removal and metadata-only additions.
An initial live driver attempt reached both outcomes but incorrectly expected the consumed request file to remain; the corrected attempt passed and its failed diagnostics were retained.
limitations: DBG2-24 remains partial: hit counts, frame windows, combined conditions, capture/event-freeze actions, menu editor, feature-gated watch execution, native Windows and physical input remain unverified or unimplemented.
